02605c2a94d7.name: Psyker
02605c2a94d7.plain: This model knows Smite plus two powers from the Librarius discipline.

0330093c0222.name: Selfless Valour
0330093c0222.plain: If an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally of this WARLORD, it can perform a Heroic Intervention. When it does, its move can be up to 6" rather than the usual 3". Apart from that, the normal Heroic Intervention restrictions apply.

0588d3d06f8c.name: Wings of Sanguinius
0588d3d06f8c.plain: If it is manifested, this PSYKER can Fall Back or make a Normal Move as though it were your Movement phase. For the rest of the phase it also gains the FLY keyword and its Move becomes 12".

06c8e52c562e.name: Strategem: Lucifer-Pattern Engines
06c8e52c562e.plain: Before the battle, one BLOOD ANGELS VEHICLE model from your army (not a DREADNOUGHT model or a model that can FLY) gains the Overcharged Engines ability.

099e6543533c.name: Death-hold
099e6543533c.plain: When this model attacks with its heavy bolter, it ignores the hit roll penalty for targeting units within Engagement Range.

0c8238a0b194.name: Mass of Doom
0c8238a0b194.plain:
If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE or BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units (not VEHICLE units) within 6" of this PRIEST model. Roll one D6:
• 1, Merciful Execution: one model in that unit is destroyed, and you add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack the unit's models make.
• 2-5, Dark Wrath: add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack the unit's models make.
• 6, Vessel of Sanguinius: the unit's models have a 4+ invulnerable save, and you add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack they make.

0e0ac2886449.name: Forlorn Fury
0e0ac2886449.plain: Once per battle, at the start of the first battle round, before any turn begins: pick one DEATH COMPANY unit from your army. It can move up to 12" (a Normal Move, as though it were your Movement phase), finishing more than 9" from every enemy model. If both players have units able to move before the first turn, whoever takes the first turn moves theirs first. Cost: 2CP if the unit includes a DREADNOUGHT model or has 6 or more models, or 1CP if not.

11bbc1b910ae.name: Crozius Arkanos
11bbc1b910ae.plain: Your opponent can't use invulnerable saves against attacks made with this weapon.

121566c30a96.name: Encarmine Broadsword
121566c30a96.plain: When this weapon attacks, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

18f01880798f.name: The Blood Lance
18f01880798f.plain: If it is manifested, pick one enemy model within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see. Draw the shortest line you can from this PSYKER's base to that model's base (or hull). For each model the centre of that line crosses, roll one D6: on a 5+, that model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

1d3d965076e6.name: 2) Might of Heroes
1d3d965076e6.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one of your <CHAPTER> CORE or <CHAPTER> CHARACTER models within 12" of this Psyker. That model adds 1 to its Strength, 1 to its Toughness and 1 to its Attacks until the start of your next Psychic phase. (When a unit has more than one Toughness value, every rule uses the lowest one.)

1dde88016b38.name: Upon Wings of Fire
1dde88016b38.plain: Use in your Movement phase. Pick one BLOOD ANGELS CORE JUMP PACK unit from your army and take it off the battlefield. In your next Movement phase's Reinforcements step, put it back anywhere that is more than 9" from all enemy models. If the battle ends while it is still off the battlefield, it counts as destroyed.

1e5b3001e359.name: Lord Regent of the Imperium Nihilus
1e5b3001e359.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and you pick this model as your Warlord, you get 1 extra Command point.

1e6000d8b66c.name: Forlorn Hero (Aura)
1e6000d8b66c.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS DEATH COMPANY CORE units is within 9" of this model, its models re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

1f6d81015f84.name: Abhor the Beast
1f6d81015f84.plain: Melee attacks this model makes against an Ork unit get 1 added to their Strength and 1 added to their Damage.

20915aab7473.name: Soul Sight
20915aab7473.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one of your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units within 18" of this Psyker. Its models can re-roll the hit roll for their ranged attacks, and targets of those attacks get no benefit from cover. This lasts until the start of your next Psychic phase.

239f96d3ec3c.name: Chapter Master
239f96d3ec3c.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your FLESH TEARERS CORE or FLESH TEARERS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. That unit's models can re-roll the hit roll for every attack they make until the start of your next Command phase.

23b3cb74b013.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
23b3cb74b013.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

247a2b28a6ea.name: Spiritual Resolve
247a2b28a6ea.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, when an enemy PSYKER manifests a psychic power that picks an EXORCISTS unit from your army. That manifestation of the power has no effect.

2530b56e11ea.name: Redeemer of the Lost (Aura)
2530b56e11ea.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS DEATH COMPANY units is within 6" of this model, it automatically passes every Morale test it takes.

2da854a84b77.name: Icon of The Angel
2da854a84b77.plain: The bearer gains the Icon of the Angel (Aura) ability: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS units is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll its charge rolls.

35e6d4ef777a.name: 5) Fury of the Ancients
35e6d4ef777a.plain: Witchfire, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one enemy model within 18" of this Psyker that it can see. Draw a line from any part of this Psyker's base to any part of that model's base (or hull). The picked model's unit, plus every other enemy unit the line goes over or through, suffers 1 mortal wound.

36e8fb2920c6.name: Fury of the Minotaurs
36e8fb2920c6.plain: While one of your MINOTAURS CORE or MINOTAURS CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll its charge rolls.

37e43eab870d.name: 6) Psychic Fortress (Aura)
37e43eab870d.plain: Blessing (Aura), warp charge 6. If it is manifested, until the start of your next Psychic phase, while one of your <CHAPTER> units is within 6" of this Psyker, its models have a 5+ invulnerable save.

3a201ac26bca.name: Epic Hero of the Imperium
3a201ac26bca.plain: Once per battle, when this model is picked for an Epic Deed Stratagem, that Stratagem costs 0 Command points.

3b5455f0f1aa.name: Ancient Armour
3b5455f0f1aa.plain: Tyberos the Red Wake has a 4+ invulnerable save.

3b812a42f51e.name: Angelic Visage
3b812a42f51e.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of any melee attack made against this model.

3d82bb91b5ef.name: Psyker
3d82bb91b5ef.plain: This model knows Smite plus 2 powers from the Librarius discipline.

41723baadb8d.name: Lord of Death
41723baadb8d.plain: Whenever this model would lose a wound, you roll one D6, and on a 5+ the wound isn't lost.

41812a803f52.name: Soulwarden (Aura)
41812a803f52.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS units is within 6" of this WARLORD, each time one of its models would lose a wound because of a mortal wound, roll one D6. On a 5+, it keeps that wound.

43149994322c.name: Master of the Forge
43149994322c.plain: When this model uses its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability to repair a model, the repaired model gets back up to 3 lost wounds, not up to D3.

434daade1a1a.name: Quickening
434daade1a1a.plain: You can re-roll the psyker's Advance and charge rolls, and you add D3 to this PSYKER's Attacks.

46acedb45d2c.name: 4) Psychic Scourge
46acedb45d2c.plain: Witchfire, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this Psyker that it can see. You roll one D6 and add this Psyker's Leadership; your opponent rolls one D6 and adds that unit's Leadership. If your total is higher, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the totals are equal, it suffers 1 mortal wound. If your total is lower, nothing happens.

492baf3e8ccf.name: Chief Librarian
492baf3e8ccf.plain: This model knows one extra psychic power from its chosen discipline, and in your opponent's Psychic phase it can try to Deny one extra psychic power.

4a783a31cfce.name: Spiritual Leaders (Aura)
4a783a31cfce.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models can use this model's Leadership instead of their own.

4cade6dcd97f.name: Fury Unbound
4cade6dcd97f.plain: You can re-roll charge rolls for any of your BLOOD ANGELS DEATH COMPANY CORE or BLOOD ANGELS DEATH COMPANY CHARACTER units while they are within 6" of this model.

5102efbbcc71.name: Magna-grapple
5102efbbcc71.plain: When an enemy VEHICLE unit (not AIRCRAFT) is picked to Fall Back while it is within Engagement Range of the bearer, you can use the magna-grapple. If you do, roll 2D6. If the total is lower than that enemy unit's Strength, it Falls Back as normal; if not, it can't Fall Back this phase and must Remain Stationary.

512cf86595dd.name: Temporal Corridor
512cf86595dd.plain:
Blessing, warp charge 5. If it is manifested, pick one of your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units within 6" of this Psyker.
• That unit can't shoot or fight this turn.
• If it isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy models, it can make a Normal Move or Advance as though it were your Movement phase. If it Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, its models add 6" to their Move until the end of the phase.

515bb6630a40.name: The Red Grail (Aura)
515bb6630a40.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE or BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units (not VEHICLE units) is within 6" of this model, and your army has the Tactical Doctrine or Devastator Doctrine active, that unit's models treat the Assault Doctrine as active for each attack they make, in place of the active doctrine.

538b76431a14.name: Shadowed Fate
538b76431a14.plain: The first time this model is destroyed, you may skip any rules that trigger on a model being destroyed and instead roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 4+, set it up again with D3 wounds left, as near as you can to the spot where it died and more than 1" from all enemy models.

542d65191a08.name: Cast Out Thy Blackened Soul
542d65191a08.plain: Use when one of your EXORCISTS CORE or EXORCISTS CHARACTER units is picked to shoot in your Shooting phase, or picked to fight in the Fight phase. Pick one enemy CHAOS DAEMON unit within 12" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, your unit's models can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against that enemy unit.

550c360411d1.name: Furioso combat weapons
550c360411d1.plain: This model gets 1 extra attack if it has 2 Furioso fists or 2 blood talons.

58e02edd1d6d.name: Artisan of War
58e02edd1d6d.plain:
This WARLORD can take one extra Special-issue Wargear Relic: Adamantine Mantle, Artificer Armour, Master-crafted Weapon or Digital Weapons.
This is on top of any other Relics it has, and every Relic in your army must still be different.

58f2fc706185.name: Visage of Death
58f2fc706185.plain:
Melee attacks against this unit subtract 1 from their hit rolls, and enemy units within 3" of the bearer lose Objective Secured.
• Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack made against this unit.
• The bearer gains the Visage of Death (Aura) ability: any enemy unit within 3" of this model loses Objective Secured, along with any similar ability that would let it control an objective marker however many enemy models are in range of that marker.

5a208fc219e0.name: Orison Cult
5a208fc219e0.plain: Use before the battle while mustering your army, if every unit in it (not counting AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM and UNALIGNED units) has the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword. Pick one EXORCISTS CORE or EXORCISTS CHARACTER unit from your army and one combat doctrine. Once per battle, in one of your Command phases, you may make that doctrine the active one for that unit, replacing any other combat doctrine, until your next Command phase starts. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, or 2CP if it has more.

5b0969bba268.name: God-splitter, Mighty Strikes
5b0969bba268.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks made with this profile. Also, an unmodified wound roll of 6 for this weapon deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

5e42c6905ebe.name: The Crimson Plate
5e42c6905ebe.plain:
The bearer moves faster, can charge after Advancing, and piles in and consolidates further.
• Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
• It can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
• Its pile-in and consolidation moves can be up to 4".

61934d7c406f.name: Psychic Hood
61934d7c406f.plain: When this model takes a Deny the Witch test, add 1 to it if the unit trying to manifest the power is within 12" of this model.

6a2852f945d4.name: Angel Ascendant
6a2852f945d4.plain: Once per battle, before the battle: pick one BLOOD ANGELS model in your army with the word 'Sergeant' in its profile. It can take one of these Special-issue Wargear Relics even though it isn't a CHARACTER model: Master-crafted Weapon, Digital Weapons, Fleshrender Grenades or Quake Bolts. Every Relic in your army must be different, and you can't use this to give one model two Relics.

6a6c250dfd73.name: Whirlwind of Gore
6a6c250dfd73.plain: When the Fight phase ends, this model can fight once more if it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

6b8fe1ec8614.name: Battle-sworn Warrior
6b8fe1ec8614.plain: You can't pick this model to be your WARLORD.

6db718f24266.name: Unleash Rage
6db718f24266.plain: Pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS units within 12" of the PSYKER. When a model in that unit makes a melee attack and rolls an unmodified 6 to hit, that attack scores 1 extra hit. This lasts until the start of your next Psychic phase.

6dd10cbc0ad9.name: The Magister's axe
6dd10cbc0ad9.plain: When this weapon attacks a Psyker unit and the saving throw is failed, the target also suffers 1 mortal wound, on top of the normal damage.

6eb02344c538.name: Psyker
6eb02344c538.plain: This model knows Smite plus three powers from the Sanguinary discipline.

72e8a025abf9.name: 1) Veil of Time

739efc9dec36.name: Savage Echoes
739efc9dec36.plain:
If every unit in your army (not counting UNALIGNED units) has the BLOOD ANGELS keyword, every unit with the Combat Doctrines ability in a BLOOD ANGELS Detachment gets this ability.

While the Assault Doctrine is active: when a unit with this ability performs a Heroic Intervention, makes a charge move or is charged, add 1 to its models' Attacks until the end of the turn. This stacks with the bonus from Shock Assault.

74e2d24c1374.name: Chalice Overflowing
74e2d24c1374.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one SANGUINARY PRIEST model from your army. It can use its Blood Chalice ability one more time this phase.

78081b8a544a.name: Shield of Sanguinius
78081b8a544a.plain: Pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS units within 12" of the psyker. It has a 5+ invulnerable save until the start of your next Psychic phase.

78e9161f7a2e.name: Light in the Dark (Aura)
78e9161f7a2e.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS DEATH COMPANY units is within 6" of this model, its models can use this model's Leadership instead of their own.

79a7f92033f0.name: Visions of Sanguinius
79a7f92033f0.plain:
Use when a DEATH COMPANY CHARACTER model from your army is picked to fight. Choose one:
• If it has already used a Death Vision, it can use one more this phase (it can't be one you have already used this battle).
• If it hasn't used a Death Vision yet, it can use two different ones this phase (neither can be one you have already used this battle).

7a14b7b64d70.name: Shrouding
7a14b7b64d70.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one of your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units within 18" of this Psyker. Enemy models can only target that unit with ranged attacks if it is the closest eligible target. This lasts until the start of your next Psychic phase.

817a61d10330.name: Blade of the Scorpion
817a61d10330.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, its Strength is x2.

857f5b8034b0.name: Speed of the Primarch
857f5b8034b0.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, if any enemy units are within Engagement Range of this WARLORD, it can fight first.

891f8b2d6b25.name: Aura of Fervour (Aura)
891f8b2d6b25.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE or BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit fights, its models get 1 extra attack until that fight is resolved. This doesn't stack with the extra attack from the Shock Assault ability or from the Honour Vehement Relic.

8a67bb2b29ce.name: Psyker
8a67bb2b29ce.plain: This model knows Smite plus two powers from the Sanguinary discipline.

8b47fa936e3c.name: Lord of Slaughter (Aura)
8b47fa936e3c.plain: Aura: while one of your FLESH TEARERS CORE units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Damage of each melee attack its models make that has an unmodified wound roll of 6.

8e52ac100539.name: Heirs of Azkaellon
8e52ac100539.plain: When a model in this unit attacks, add 1 to the hit roll if its unit is within 6" of any of your BLOOD ANGELS WARLORD models.

8fc2acaab405.name: Mind Raid
8fc2acaab405.plain:
Witchfire, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, pick one enemy model within 18" of this Psyker that it can see.
• That model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• If the model is a Character, roll 3D6. If the total equals or beats its Leadership, you gain 1 Command Point.

9331674da291.name: Refusal to Die
9331674da291.plain: Once per turn, after a DEATH COMPANY unit from your army is chosen as the target of an attack: for the rest of the phase, roll one D6 whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound, and on a 5+ it keeps the wound. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, or 2CP if it has more.

94bfbe876d3a.name: Blood Boil
94bfbe876d3a.plain: If it is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see, and roll 2D6. If the total beats the highest Toughness in that unit, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the total is more than twice that highest Toughness, it suffers 3 mortal wounds instead.

94d9270d20b2.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
94d9270d20b2.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGEL CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

96d54085085e.name: Frag cannon
96d54085085e.plain: Every attack with this Blast weapon hits its target automatically.

973129ac5427.name: Rage unto Death
973129ac5427.plain: This model can charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

9735b07f67a3.name: Heroic Bearing
9735b07f67a3.plain:
• This WARLORD's abilities Rites of Battle, Tactical Precision, Chapter Master and Spiritual Leaders each get 3" more range (but no more than 9").
• This WARLORD also gains this ability: Heroic Bearing (Aura): while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE units is within 9" of this WARLORD, its models add 1 to their Leadership.

9a6a42b0e6fe.name: Stampeding Fury
9a6a42b0e6fe.plain: Whenever this model makes a charge move, you can pick one enemy unit in Engagement Range of it and roll one D6 (add 1 if the enemy unit is a VEHICLE). On a 3-5, the enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

9ad268655216.name: Combat Restoratives
9ad268655216.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can have this model heal one BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY or BLOOD ANGELS BIKER model from your army if that model's unit is within 3" of it. The model gets back up to D3 lost wounds. A model can't be healed more than once per turn.

9b159c57e22d.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
9b159c57e22d.plain: Aura: while one of your FLESH TEARERS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

9bc2f8be86b1.name: Purity of Aspect, Action and Intent
9bc2f8be86b1.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your RED SCORPIONS CORE or RED SCORPIONS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. That unit's models add 1 to their Attacks until the start of your next Command phase.

9c24a3d1922a.name: Psychic Hood
9c24a3d1922a.plain: When you take Deny the Witch tests for this model against enemy PSYKERS within 12", you can add 1 to them.

9c8b27af8153.name: Lord of Ruin
9c8b27af8153.plain: Whenever this model attacks, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

9cc1c7d36f99.name: Chief Librarian
9cc1c7d36f99.plain: This model knows one extra psychic power from its chosen discipline, and in your opponent's Psychic phase it can try to deny one extra psychic power.

9e7103f51e2b.name: Invocation of Destruction
9e7103f51e2b.plain:
If this litany is inspiring, one of your BLOOD ANGELS units within 6" of this model gets Armour Penetration -4 on melee attacks with an unmodified 6 to wound.
You choose which unit.

a001977917b5.name: Chapter Banner
a001977917b5.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack its models make.

a283c94185e6.name: Severer
a283c94185e6.plain: Only for a model with a chainsword: this Relic replaces its chainsword and uses the profile below.

a3561354dc08.name: Artificer flamer
a3561354dc08.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically.

a4f87a2a968e.name: Gift of Foresight
a4f87a2a968e.plain: Once in each turn you can re-roll a hit roll for this WARLORD, once you can re-roll a wound roll for it, and once you can re-roll a saving throw for it.

a62d0a88463f.name: Furioso force halberd
a62d0a88463f.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can never make more than 1 attack with this weapon.

a667ab9a8441.name: Guardian of the Lost
a667ab9a8441.plain: When this model recites a litany that tells you to pick a friendly unit, you can only pick a unit that also has the DEATH COMPANY keyword (as well as any other keywords the litany needs). When this model recites a litany that is an aura ability, it only affects units that also have the DEATH COMPANY keyword (as well as any other keywords it needs).

a8b7855fe90e.name: Angel Exemplar
a8b7855fe90e.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate a BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER model that isn't a named character as your WARLORD: give it one extra Warlord Trait. A model from the Blood Angels or a Blood Angels successor Chapter (except the Flesh Tearers) takes it from the Blood Angels Warlord Traits table; a model from the Flesh Tearers Chapter takes it from the Flesh Tearers Warlord Traits table. No two Warlord Traits in your army can be the same (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly).

ac3488f22636.name: Master of Devastation
ac3488f22636.plain: If this model is on the battlefield the first time you use the Orbital Bombardment Stratagem, that use of it costs 0CP.

ae733a9e8a90.name: Unbridled Ardour
ae733a9e8a90.plain: At the end of the Heroic Interventions step in your opponent's Charge phase: pick a SANGUINARY GUARD unit in your army that has an enemy unit within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it. That unit can perform a Heroic Intervention as though it were a CHARACTER unit, and its models can move up to 6" (not 3") when they do. The rest of the Heroic Intervention rules apply as normal.

ae8ccc50d38d.name: Leap into the Fray
ae8ccc50d38d.plain: When this model ends a charge move, you can pick one enemy unit in Engagement Range and roll one D6. On a 4+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

ae8d434ce0bd.name: Savagery beyond Reason (Aura)
ae8d434ce0bd.plain: Aura: while one of your CARCHARODONS CORE or CARCHARODONS CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Strength of each melee attack its models make.

afd88b4d5a48.name: Perdition Pistol
afd88b4d5a48.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon hits, draw a line from the closest point of this model's base (or hull) to the closest point of the nearest model in the target unit. Roll to wound once against the target unit, and once against each other unit that line crosses (ignore units that weren't eligible targets for this weapon when you chose targets).

b2b1f5a92a1b.name: Lucifer-pattern Engines
b2b1f5a92a1b.plain: Use before the battle. Pick one BLOOD ANGELS VEHICLE model from your army (not a DREADNOUGHT model or a model that can FLY). It gains this ability: Overcharged Engines: when this model Advances, don't roll for the Advance; instead, add 6" to its Move until the end of the phase.

b3009e474bd9.name: The Red Thirst
b3009e474bd9.plain: In any turn in which this model's unit was charged, made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention, add 1 to the wound roll for this model's melee attacks. Also, add 1 to the Advance roll or charge roll whenever a unit with this ability Advances or makes a charge move.

b378f047b086.name: Cut Them Down (Aura)
b378f047b086.plain: Aura: while one of your ASTRAL CLAWS CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit fights you can re-roll one of its hit rolls and one of its wound rolls.

b8707029b880.name: Battlesworn Warrior
b8707029b880.plain: You can't pick this model as your Warlord.

b900eab54bdb.name: Chief Librarian
b900eab54bdb.plain: Once per battle, before the battle: pick one BLOOD RAVENS LIBRARIAN model from your army. It gains the CHIEF LIBRARIAN keyword and this ability: Chief Librarian: this model knows one extra psychic power from its chosen discipline, and in your opponent's Psychic phase it can try to deny one extra psychic power.

bb30494a5cb5.name: Gallian's Staff
bb30494a5cb5.plain: Add 1 to every Psychic test this model takes to manifest a power from the Sanguinary discipline.

bbaaecae65d2.name: Chapter Master
bbaaecae65d2.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE or BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. That unit's models can re-roll the hit roll for every attack they make until the start of your next Command phase.

be333ee26cc1.name: Savage Destruction
be333ee26cc1.plain: Use in the Morale phase, when an enemy unit fails a Morale test while it is in Engagement Range of any of your FLESH TEARERS units. For the rest of the turn, Combat Attrition tests for that enemy unit get 1 subtracted from them.

c49d4f46df00.name: Priest
c49d4f46df00.plain: This model knows the Litany of Hate and two more litanies of your choice from the Litanies of Battle. In your Command phase, if it is on the battlefield, it can recite up to two of its litanies, even if another friendly model already recited them this battle round (though a unit can only be affected by a given litany once per battle round). Roll one D6 for each: on a 3+ that litany is inspiring and lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

c5799dd574fb.name: God-splitter, Sweeping Blows
c5799dd574fb.plain: If you pick this profile, this weapon makes 3 extra attacks.

c5d29ec165eb.name: Chapter Master (Flesh Tearers)
c5d29ec165eb.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your FLESH TEARERS CORE or FLESH TEARERS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. That unit's models can re-roll the hit roll for every attack they make until the start of your next Command phase.

c9623d9b05aa.name: Vengeance for Sanguinius
c9623d9b05aa.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your BLOOD ANGELS units is picked to fight. For the rest of the phase, its models can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll for melee attacks against BLACK LEGION units.

cc5ee438c241.name: 3. Cretacian Born
cc5ee438c241.plain: Enemy units targeted by a charge this WARLORD declares can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend against that charge. You can also re-roll charge rolls made for this WARLORD.

d344451aa053.name: Battle Alchemistry
d344451aa053.plain: In your Command phase, this model can perform alchemy on one of your ASTRAL CLAWS CORE units within 3" of it (Primaris units can't be picked). Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Strength of every ranged attack that unit's models make with bolt weapons.

d7066d302b5c.name: Spiritual Might
d7066d302b5c.plain: Use in your Psychic phase. Pick one BLOOD ANGELS PSYKER unit from your army. This phase, it can try to manifest one extra psychic power.

d798a5068510.name: 3) Null Zone (Aura)

d8391bf4dd69.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
d8391bf4dd69.plain: When this unit takes a Combat Attrition test, you can ignore any or all modifiers to it.

db34dfb0ff6f.name: Angel’s Sacrifice
db34dfb0ff6f.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Pick one BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER unit (not a VEHICLE unit) from your army. Until the end of the phase, whenever an enemy unit is picked to fight, if any of its models is within Engagement Range of that CHARACTER unit when your opponent picks targets, those attacks must target that CHARACTER unit.

dbca417c2386.name: 1. Merciless Butcher
dbca417c2386.plain: Whenever this WARLORD is picked to fight, it makes 1 extra attack with one of its melee weapons for each five enemy models within 3" of it, up to a maximum of 3 extra attacks.

e0c6f738c3bc.name: Aggressive Onslaught
e0c6f738c3bc.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Pick one FLESH TEARERS INFANTRY unit from your army. For the rest of the phase, its models can go up to 3" further than normal when they pile in or consolidate.

e120f4804266.name: Narthecium (Aura)
e120f4804266.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY or BLOOD ANGELS BIKER units is within 3" of this model, roll one D6 each time one of its models would lose a wound. On a 6, it keeps that wound.

e26da1f4f53d.name: Sanguinary High Priest
e26da1f4f53d.plain: This model can use its Combat Restoratives ability two times at the end of your Movement phase, not just once.

e35dc67a15f8.name: Hallucination

e5ec9b92da46.name: Descent of Angels

e733129356a9.name: Astartes Banner (Aura)
e733129356a9.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models add 1 to their Leadership. Also, when a model in such a unit is killed by an enemy model's attack, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave it on the table for now: once the attacking unit has finished all its attacks, the dead model can either shoot with one of its ranged weapons as though it were your Shooting phase, or attack once with one of its melee weapons as though it were the Fight phase. Then remove it.

e867e2626db5.name: Avenging Angel
e867e2626db5.plain: This model can declare a charge even if it Fell Back this turn. It is eligible to perform a Heroic Intervention when an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically (rather than 3" horizontally and 5" vertically), and its Heroic Intervention moves can go up to 6" rather than 3". The rest of the Heroic Intervention rules apply as normal.

e91effb66f37.name: Psyker
e91effb66f37.plain: This model knows Smite plus 2 powers from the Obscuration discipline.

ea3cb7ca3dfe.name: Bane of the Damned
ea3cb7ca3dfe.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your RED SCORPIONS CORE units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, its models can re-roll the wound roll for attacks against PSYKER units.

eb0e8d37e70e.name: Red Rampage
eb0e8d37e70e.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your army has the Assault Doctrine active: until your next Command phase, whenever a BLOOD ANGELS model from your army attacks with a Pistol or melee weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1. This stacks with the Combat Doctrines ability.

eb8b7c1a0f3f.name: 2. Of Wrath and Rage
eb8b7c1a0f3f.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

ec2b0389fa3b.name: Tenebrous Curse
ec2b0389fa3b.plain:
Malediction, warp charge 7. If it is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this Psyker that it can see and that can't Fly.
• That unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• Halve that unit's Move characteristic, and subtract 2 from its Advance rolls and charge rolls.

f1222dcad0ab.name: God-splitter
f1222dcad0ab.plain: When you choose to fire this weapon, pick one of the profiles listed below.

f1e1d9671666.name: Catechist
f1e1d9671666.plain: When an attack with this weapon targets a unit within half range, its Damage is D6+2. This is a melta weapon.

f4ccf10aa105.name: Honoured by the Arx Angelicum
f4ccf10aa105.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate a model from a Blood Angels successor Chapter as your WARLORD: one CHARACTER model in your army from a Blood Angels successor Chapter can take one Relic of the Angels, in place of a Special-issue Wargear Relic or a Chapter Relic. If you do, every BLOOD ANGELS keyword on that Relic (if it has any) becomes that model's successor Chapter keyword.

f4e4d382feb3.name: Wrath of Baal
f4e4d382feb3.plain:
Sanguinary Ancient model only: the bearer gains an aura that gives your BLOOD ANGELS JUMP PACK units within 6" an extra 2" of Move.
• Wrath of Baal (Aura): while one of your BLOOD ANGELS JUMP PACK units is within 6" of this model, each time it is picked to make a Normal Move, Advance or Fall Back, its Move characteristic goes up by 2" until the phase ends.

f59f3911597b.name: Blood Chalice
f59f3911597b.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your BLOOD ANGELS CORE or BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units (not VEHICLE units) within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, while your army has the Tactical Doctrine or Devastator Doctrine active, the unit's models treat the Assault Doctrine as active for each of their attacks instead.

f724fa6d54a7.name: Miraculous Saviour
f724fa6d54a7.plain: At the end of the Heroic Interventions step in your opponent's Charge phase, if this model is not yet on the battlefield and any enemy units ended a charge move this phase within Engagement Range of any of your BLOOD ANGELS units, you can place this model within Engagement Range of one of those enemy units. In that turn, it counts as having performed a Heroic Intervention.

f821957e0be5.name: Severer
f821957e0be5.plain: Each unmodified wound roll of 5+ for an attack with this weapon also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

fba41ba55983.name: Blood Biter
fba41ba55983.plain: When this weapon attacks an Infantry unit, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

ff95a7cc5d7e.name: Priest
ff95a7cc5d7e.plain: This model knows the Litany of Hate, Mass of Doom (described below) and two more litanies of your choice from the Litanies of Battle. In your Command phase, if it is on the battlefield, it can recite up to two of its litanies, as long as no other friendly model has recited them yet this battle round.
